verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a static HTTP API reference overview and a link to an OpenAPI contract, but nothing about an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples. The documented OpenAPI contract location also returns 404 on both hosts. CLI schema printouts with worked examples are a different feature and earn no credit for an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
